## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry limit must be corrected before merge because the new helper exceeds the governing five-attempt cap.

## Changes
The pull request adds configurable retries, tests, a review fixture, and a policy amendment raising the cap to ten. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Cap retry attempts at five — With a persistently failing upstream, the default call makes ten attempts, violating “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5” (`AGENTS.md:5`); validation also accepts explicit limits of six through ten. — During sustained upstream failures, callers double the permitted request volume, exceeding the policy’s outage-prevention limit. — Fix: Set the default and validation cap to five, and align the docstring and tests with that limit.
